title: Dakgalbi (spicy chicken with cabbage and sweet potato)
steps: Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, garlic, ginger and maple syrup, cut the chicken into pieces and marinate for 15 minutes.
Thinly slice the sweet potato, cut the cabbage into large pieces and the onion into strips.
Fry the sweet potato in the oil in a large pan for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken with its marinade, the cabbage and onion and fry for 10–12 minutes, turning, until the chicken is cooked.
Sprinkle with spring onions and sesame.
